name: Blackjack
tagline: Blackjack a move at a time: the cards drawn in the chat, and the table in Canvas.

fields.name: move
fields.note: deal, hit, stand, double, show, or new; left out, deal when no hand is in play, else show

fields.name: bet
fields.note: chips to bet on a deal; the last bet when left out, 10 at a new table

fields.name: seed
fields.note: a number that fixes the shuffle, so a game plays again card for card; a fresh shuffle when left out

fields.name: chips
fields.note: chips to sit down with at a new table; 100 when left out

fields.name: table
fields.note: where the table's picture is kept, in the folder; blackjack/table.png when left out
